subject: Onsite access prep: NovaPower HQ — badging & escorted access
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Rios <emily.rios@novapower.com>
Cc: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@novapower.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite access prep: NovaPower HQ — badging & escorted access

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for scheduling the exec workshop at NovaPower HQ on May 18–19. We're finalizing attendee logistics and need to confirm your visitor access and badging process so our team can move through security smoothly. Key asks: 

- Is pre-registration required for all visitors? If so, please confirm the data fields you need (full name, DOB, driver/license, company, role).
- Do visitors need to complete an NDA or site-specific safety briefing ahead of arrival?
- Are background checks required for any of our engineers who will need server room access?
- Parking & arrival instructions for two sprinter vans arriving between 08:00–08:30 on May 18.

I've attached a draft visitor access form (visitor_access_form.pdf) with the tentative attendee list columns. We'll replace with a CSV once final. Also looping in Marissa (events) and Jorge (your facilities lead) for any facility-specific constraints.

If it's easier, happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: visitor_access_form.pdf (fillable PDF - attendee fields)
From: Emily Rios <emily.rios@novapower.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@novapower.com>, Facility Security <security@novapower.com>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite access prep: NovaPower HQ — badging & escorted access

Connor,

Thanks for the note — welcome to NovaPower. Quick answers below and a few next steps.

- Pre-registration: Yes, all visitors must be pre-registered 72 hours in advance. Required fields: full legal name, date of birth, government ID type & number (we accept driver license or passport), company, job title, mobile number, and the staff host.
- NDA/safety briefing: We require a short site safety acknowledgment (we'll send a link) but no separate NDA for short visits. If you'll be handling any sensitive equipment, we'll flag room-level briefings.
- Background checks: Not required for general attendees. Background checks are required for unescorted server room access; those need to be initiated at least 10 business days prior and require full legal name + SSN (US) or national ID (international).
- Parking: Two van spaces are available in Visitor Lot B; please arrive via Gate 3. Driver names and vehicle models helpful for entry.

I've attached the standard site security guide (site-security-SLA.pdf) and the link to our online visitor registration (https://novapower-visitors.example/register).

If you can send the completed form and a finalized headcount by Monday EOD (May 4), we can pre-print badges and schedule escorts.

Best,
Emily Rios
Senior Facilities Coordinator
NovaPower
emily.rios@novapower.com

Attachment: site-security-SLA.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite access prep: NovaPower HQ — badging & escorted access

Connor / Marissa,

Quick check from CS/Workshop ops:
- Final headcount: 12 (6 leadership, 4 platform engineers, 2 product).
- Of those, two engineers (Rishi Malhotra and Mina Haddad) will need temporary access to the secure rack room for a short demo on Day 1 — they will be escorted, but if background checks are needed we should start that now.
- Any dietary/special access notes for execs? (Marissa, please confirm).

Connor — can you compile the attendee CSV and include driver's license types (to match their requirement)? I'll coordinate meals and meeting-room entry timing once badges are confirmed.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Rios <emily.rios@novapower.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite access prep: NovaPower HQ — badging & escorted access

Emily,

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is the finalized badging CSV (attendee_badging_list.csv) with full legal names, DOB, ID type/number placeholders, company, role, mobile, and host assignment. We have 12 attendees total. Two (Rishi Malhotra, Mina Haddad) will need escorted access to the rack room for a 45-minute demo on May 18 at 10:30. Please confirm whether we should submit SSNs for the short-term background check or if an escorted demo without checks is acceptable under your policy.

Driver details for the vans:
- Alejandro Santos (white Ford Transit)
- Priya Natarajan (silver Mercedes Sprinter)

If you prefer, I can upload the CSV directly to the link you sent. Also linking our shared sheet for any last-minute edits: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XqExampleBadgingList

Thanks,
Connor

Attachment: attendee_badging_list.csv
From: Emily Rios <emily.rios@novapower.com>

Cc: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@novapower.com>, Facility Security <security@novapower.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite access prep: NovaPower HQ — badging & escorted access

Connor,

Thanks — we've received the CSV and pre-registered all 12 visitors. A few confirmations: 

- Rack room access: For temporary escorted access (with a host present at all times) we do NOT require SSNs/background checks. If you need unescorted access or permanent credentials, we'll need the checks. So Rishi & Mina are fine to be escorted for the demo.
- Badge pickup: Please have your host (Lauren) check in at Visitor Desk A on arrival to collect printed badges. Escort will meet you there and will remain with the group.
- Parking & arrival: Park in Visitor Lot B, enter Gate 3. Please use the main security kiosk and present the printed confirmation I sent from our visitor portal. Vans will be directed to drop-off area 2 for luggage/equipment; someone from facilities will assist with a loading dock pass.
- Prohibited items: No tripod-mounted cameras or network sniffers allowed on-site. If you have specialized test equipment, provide a short equipment list and we'll coordinate an escorted location.

I've added a quick DocuSign link for the site safety acknowledgment; ask attendees to complete before arrival if possible to speed entry: https://app.docusign.com/secure/DocuSignExampleLink

Looking forward to hosting you. If any last-minute changes, ping Jorge or me.

Best,
Emily Rios
Senior Facilities Coordinator | NovaPower
emily.rios@novapower.com
